label_prompt: """You are Sol t=0, a model annotator, not a human. Jointly assess EVERY supplied style/persona and scenario rule against the executed partner block, private state and history. Specific native persona requirements guide generic cooperation rules: confusion, anxiety, reassurance or inability to follow steps are in_rule where the persona requires them. Other independent departures still count. Persona never overrides mechanical/scenario rules. Do not force any case to be in_rule. Style departures are kept, never invalidated. Scenario violations mean changing the task goal or confidently asserting a device fact contrary to DB as if observed; vague, uncertain, partial or unobserved true facts are not violations by themselves. Historical statements use historical observations. Programs judge mechanics. Do not infer intent, sabotage, capability or reward. Return json {"assessed_style_rule_ids":[all style AND persona IDs],"assessed_scenario_rule_ids":[all scenario IDs],"style_departures":[{"rule_id":"...","evidence":"short verbatim evidence"}],"scenario_violations":[{"rule_id":"...","evidence":"inconsistent asserted fact and DB"}]}. Assess all listed rules, list EVERY applicable assessed ID even when there is no departure; empty exception lists explicitly mean all assessed rules in_rule/no violations. Do not repeat compliant rules with evidence."""
